material_type: commercial SPT solutions and allergy vaccines
Skin prick test (SPT) solutions and allergy vaccines (AVs) are crucial tools for diagnosis and therapy of allergies.

disease_state.evidence: It was the aim of this study to corroborate the content of products for diagnosis and treatment of dust mite allergies that are produced and sold in India.

sample_source.evidence: SDS-PAGE, immunoblots and high-resolution mass spectrometric analysis was performed with 16 house dust mite (HDM) SPT solutions and AVs from 3 Indian manufacturers.

species.evidence: From the 5 Indian Dermatophagoides pteronyssinus products, none contained proteins from this source.
